changes: First import: BD ANALOG for the Analog Rytm MKII, a digital voice machine on the Modwerk base (repeat98/modwerk#1447): Analog BD's 808 and 909 (0.1.7) in fixed-point C and ColdFire assembly, machine slot 36 in the BD section, offered on the BD, SD and BT tracks.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
